title: #102 Life Experience
prompt: Some people argue that experience is the best teacher, saying life experiences teach people more effectively than books or formal education can. How far do you agree with this statement? Give your reason or provide your personal experience.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

plans.label: Version 1: AGREE
plans.thesisFrame: In my view, Education should be considered from the perspective of agree.
plans.point1: Practical exposure is valuable because real-world situations force people to apply theoretical knowledge, leading to crucial problem-solving abilities and financial resilience.
plans.point2: Furthermore, life experiences build emotional intelligence and adaptability, which is necessary for navigating complex social dynamics like workplace conflict.

plans.label: Version 2: DISAGREE
plans.thesisFrame: In my view, Education should be considered from the perspective of disagree.
plans.point1: Formal education provides theoretical knowledge but often fails to prepare students for the practical complexities of real life, as demonstrated by the gap between learning economic theories and experiencing a financial downturn.
plans.point2: Self-directed learning through life events builds essential emotional intelligence and resilience, as overcoming personal setbacks teaches self-reliance and adaptability that classrooms cannot replicate.
